title: Manifest
description: Manifest for a mod, modpack, datapack, or resourcepack. A manifest is either single-version (has 'mc_version') or multi-variant (has 'variants'), never both. Every manifest must declare a 'role'.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor autocomplete.

id.description: Stable project identifier. Matches the project's folder name.

loader.description: Mod loader (e.g. fabric, forge, neoforge, quilt). Required for single-version modpacks. For multi-variant projects this is the default loader; individual variants may override it with their own 'loader'.

version.description: Project version. Required for production manifests; generated for experimental builds.

mc_version.description: Minecraft version. Single-version manifests. Mutually exclusive with 'variants'.

variants.description: Independently-built variants published as separate versions under one project. Each variant may set its own loader and, for mods, its Stonecutter Gradle project. Publish order = array order (last lands on top).

loader.description: Loader for this variant (e.g. fabric, forge, neoforge, quilt). Overrides the pack-level 'loader'. If omitted, the pack-level 'loader' applies.

gradle_project.description: Stonecutter Gradle subproject that builds this mod variant (for example, '26.1.2-fabric'). Required for type 'mod'.

github_id.description: GitHub owner/repo slug if the pack is distributed via GitHub Releases.

gitea_id.description: Forgejo/Gitea/Codeberg owner/repo slug if the pack is distributed via a Forgejo-compatible forge.

gitlab_id.description: GitLab project path (owner/repo) if the pack is distributed via GitLab.

lifecycle.description: Pack maintenance state. 'archived' and 'eol' packs are excluded from workspace auto-update operations. If omitted, 'active' is assumed.

role.description: REQUIRED. Declares this pack's performance relationship. One of: 'none' (standalone), 'base' (a performance base others consume), or an object declaring the base this pack consumes from. Forces every pack to state its role explicitly rather than by omission.

oneOf.description: 'none' = standalone; 'base' = this pack is a performance base.
This pack consumes its performance baseline from another pack.

performance_base.description: Sync copies the base's named source subdir into this pack's named target subdir per mapping. cross platform is forbidden cuz source and target must share the same platform suffix (-mr/-cf), since copying Modrinth mods into a CurseForge pack (or vice versa) risks license violations.

pack.description: ID of the base pack. Must exist and have role 'base'.

source.description: Subdir in the base to copy from. Must end -mr or -cf.

target.description: Subdir in THIS pack to copy into. Same platform suffix as source.

shared_assets.description: ID of a pack providing shared assets (e.g. 'lce-common'). Must exist. Independent of 'role' — a pack of any role may also use shared assets.

automation.description: Per-pack automation settings consumed by packwand and the changelog generator. Replaces the old opt-out.json.

auto_update.description: false: packwand update / loader-update skip this pack.

server_promo.description: false: changelogs omit the BisectHosting block.

sync_exclude.description: Paths sync never copies into this consumer.

sync_on_build.description: Run configured same-pack variant syncs before build and publish.

freeze.description: Frozen (pinned) mods per subdir key, maintained by 'packwand freeze'.

full_auto.description: Opts this pack into the unattended release pipeline ('packwand automation run'): update -> refresh -> validate -> tests -> docs -> bump. Requires 'version' to already follow the CalVer 'YY.MM' or 'YY.MM.patch' pattern. Ignored (treated as disabled) when 'lifecycle' is 'archived' or 'eol'.

enabled.description: true: a scheduled workflow may update, validate, test, and version-bump this pack unattended.

tests.description: Shell commands run from the pack dir before bump; a nonzero exit aborts the run and discards update/refresh changes.
